repo.head: 49c9794895666d029a3c98a48afd872197d83b23
repo.note: pinned S0 provenance commit; remote HEAD at clone time was identical (git ls-remote verified, no drift)

env.platform: macOS (Darwin 25.5.0, arm64), CPU-only, no CUDA/NVML, no cmake

packages.langchain: 0.3.30 (<1 required: langchain 1.x removed langchain.text_splitter shim used by RAGPerf)

patches.change: wrap non-lancedb vector-DB client imports (milvus/qdrant/chroma/elastic) and vLLM/ColPali/ragas-dependent imports (ImagesRAGPipeline, VLLMResponser, ImageResponser, ColPaliEncoder, RagasEvaluator, RagasOpenAI, Ragasvllm) in try/except ImportError -> None; lancedb + text loader imports stay unguarded
patches.reason: S0 blocker: entrypoint imports all runtime deps eagerly before argument handling, so even --help failed without vLLM/pymilvus/etc.

patches.change: insert-path SentenceTransformerEncoder(device="cuda:0") -> device=config["rag"]["embedding"].get("device", "cpu") (query path already read device from config)
patches.reason: S0 blocker: text insert path hardcodes cuda:0, blocking CPU-only insert

patches.change: query-phase gate now also enters when config rag.action.retrieval is true (key existed in configs but was never read by code)
patches.reason: S0 blocker: text query path only runs when generation=true

patches.change: after WikipediaRequests construction, optionally inject RAGRequest.query_list from RAGPERF_SYNTHETIC_QUERIES env JSON; uses the class's own query_list branch in get_questions
patches.reason: queries otherwise hard-bound to downloading HF sentence-transformers/natural-questions; synthetic 2-query set stands in

patches.change: instantiate VLLMResponser only when generation=true, else responser=None
patches.reason: S0 blocker: query path unconditionally instantiates VLLMResponser (requires vLLM/GPU)

patches.change: guard module-top imports of VLLMResponser (pulls vllm) and RagasEvaluator (pulls ragas/FlagEmbedding) with try/except -> None; names only used as annotations/optional components
patches.reason: S0 blocker: vLLM import chain triggered by importing the text pipeline module itself

patches.change: process(): skip load_llm/query_llm/free_llm when responser is None; responses default to empty strings; generation timing variables kept so text_pipeline_stats.txt column layout is unchanged (generation ~0 ns)
patches.reason: retrieval-only execution: generation step must be skippable without restructuring the pipeline

patches.change: guard 'from vectordb.milvus_api import milvus_client' (pymilvus) with try/except -> None; only used as a type annotation
patches.reason: S0 blocker: eager import chain; pymilvus outside minimal CPU deps

patches.change: pass device to SentenceTransformer(...) by keyword instead of positionally (2nd positional is `modules`; sentence-transformers >=5 makes it keyword-only and raises TypeError)
patches.reason: newly discovered blocker: positional-device call is incompatible with installed sentence-transformers 5.6.0 (and latently wrong against older signatures too)

patches.change: free_encoder(): guard torch.cuda.synchronize/empty_cache/ipc_collect behind torch.cuda.is_available(), plain gc.collect() on CPU
patches.reason: newly discovered blocker: unconditional torch.cuda.* teardown crashes on CPU-only torch

patches.change: if RAGPERF_LOCAL_WIKI_JSON env var set, load corpus via datasets.load_dataset("json", data_files={train: path}) instead of hub wikimedia/wikipedia 20231101.en; get_dataset_slice untouched
patches.reason: corpus otherwise hard-bound to multi-GB HF hub download unavailable locally; loader is dataset-name-bound so an isomorphic local JSONL is injected

patches.change: wrap three module-level env-setup blocks in try/except with logged warnings: (1) proto.*_pb2 probe-macro imports (CMake-generated, absent), (2) pynvml.nvmlInit + GPU list (no NVML on macOS; degrades to []), (3) find_device_for_path which reads Linux-only /proc/mounts and probes /mnt/data1 (degrades to empty disk list, pids still collected via psutil)
patches.reason: newly discovered blocker: monitor config parser crashes at import time on non-Linux/non-CUDA hosts before any RAG code runs

patches.change: pure-Python no-op stand-in for the CMake-built libmsys cpython extension: initialize/getMonitoringSystem/testRun/reportStatus/startRecording/stopRecording; exposes no add*ToSystem meter functions, so monitor configs must declare zero meters
patches.reason: newly discovered blocker (hard): monitoring backend is a C++ cpython module built by cmake against Linux /proc + NVML; unbuildable here (no cmake, macOS). Sidecar-only: RAG pipeline code itself is unaffected

synthetic_dataset.format_basis: Corpus: TextDatasetLoader.get_dataset_slice (src/datasetLoader/TextDatasetLoader.py, pristine lines 28-46) consumes HF Dataset columns 'text' and 'id'; JSONL mirrors the full wikimedia/wikipedia schema (id/url/title/text), loaded via datasets json loader. Queries: WikipediaRequests.get_questions query_list branch (src/RAGRequest/TextsRAGRequest.py lines 20-24) slices {'questions': [...], 'ground_truth_answers': [...]}, mirroring the query/answer columns of its default sentence-transformers/natural-questions download. Files: /tmp/ragperf-s1-20260706/data/synthetic_wiki_50.jsonl, /tmp/ragperf-s1-20260706/data/synthetic_queries.json; generator: /tmp/ragperf-s1-20260706/make_synthetic_data.py. Docs kept <512 chars so RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(chunk_size=512, overlap=0) yields exactly 1 chunk/doc (50 chunks). Two docs are deliberate targets of the two queries.

deviations: Python 3.12.6 used; README recommends conda python=3.10
cmake absent: official 'make generate_py3_requirements' dependency resolution skipped; minimal CPU dep set hand-picked instead (lancedb pinned to requirements.in's 0.24.3)

monitoring subsystem no-oped: libmsys C++ extension unbuildable on macOS (cmake + Linux /proc + NVML); zero-meter monitor config + Python stub, so no resource monitoring data was collected (S0 had planned CPU/Mem/Proc meters)
corpus: 50-doc synthetic JSONL stands in for wikimedia/wikipedia 20231101.en; queries: 2 synthetic Q/A stand in for sentence-transformers/natural-questions
embedding model all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is the example config's own default (no swap needed; ~90MB, fetched from HF hub during insert run)
build_index: false in tiny insert config (example uses IVF_HNSW_SQ): 50-row table retrieves via flat scan; index-build code path untested
sentence-transformers 5.6.0 vs the (unpinned) ~3.x era implied by upstream's vllm==0.8.0 pin; required the device-keyword patch
langchain pinned <1 (0.3.30) because langchain 1.x removed the langchain.text_splitter shim RAGPerf imports
generation/reranking/evaluation paths not executed (out of scope for CPU retrieval smoke): vLLM/ragas never imported successfully by design

workspace hygiene: an orphaned concurrent writer (leftover from an earlier background-agent attempt) briefly raced this directory; workspace was renamed to /tmp/ragperf-s1-20260706-claimed mid-task, repo reset to pristine 49c9794 before patching (foreign edits snapshotted to foreign-writer-snapshot.txt), and renamed back on completion. Config/log file contents therefore reference the -claimed path; venv console-script shebangs broke on rename (use venv/bin/python -m pip)

time_break_down_monotonic_ns_marks.note: embed segment includes first-time HF fetch + CPU load of all-MiniLM-L6-v2; smoke evidence only, not performance data

metrics.note: values are RAGPerf's own text_pipeline_stats.txt row (round 0); generation ~0 because responser=None on the retrieval-only path; smoke evidence only
metrics.semantic_sanity: query 1 top-1 = Mount Kilimanjaro doc, query 2 top-1 = Penicillin/Fleming doc (intended targets); per-query hit lengths in run/query.out

blockers_remaining: faithful (non-stub) monitoring requires Linux + cmake + C++ toolchain + NVML to build libmsys, plus generated proto/*_pb2; impossible on this macOS host regardless of cmake
generation path (VLLMResponser) and evaluation (ragas/vllm) still require GPU/vLLM environment: untested here by design
index build (IVF_HNSW_SQ) untested: tiny corpus used flat search

upstream code assumes older dep era: two latent bugs patched here (positional device arg to SentenceTransformer; unconditional torch.cuda teardown) would need upstreaming or version pinning for reproducible runs
wikimedia/wikipedia + natural-questions full datasets remain undownloaded locally (multi-GB): real-corpus S1 would need disk+bandwidth budget or a Linux runner
